ephemeral e·phem·er·al | əˈfem(ə)rəl | adjective lasting for a very short time: fashions are ephemeral. • (chiefly of plants) having a very short life cycle: chickweed is an ephemeral weed, producing several generations in one season. noun an ephemeral plant: ephemerals avoid the periods of drought as seeds. DERIVATIVES ephemerality | əˌfem(ə)ˈralədē | noun ephemerally | əˈfem(ə)rəlē, ēˈfem(ə)rəlē | adverb ephemeralness | əˈfem(ə)rəlnəs, ēˈfem(ə)rəlnəs | noun ORIGIN late 16th century: from Greek ephēmeros (see ephemera) + -al.
